title.narrative: Karnataka Integrated and Sustainable Water Resources Management Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The investment program will improve water availability in selected river basins in Karnataka by implementing integrated water resources management (IWRM). Output 1 of Project 2 will: (i) prepare the middle Krishna Basin Plan; (ii) expand the state water resources information system; and (iii) continue strengthening WRD staff with IWRM training. Output 2 will modernize the Vijayanagara Channels subproject to: (i) reduce irrigation water consumption; and (ii) improve water delivery service to allow farmers to increase cropping intensities. Under Output 2, the project will also establish and strengthen 30 water user cooperative societies and provide gender sensitization training to WRD staff and WUCS.

title.narrative: Loan 3836: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 09 Mar 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: Project declared effective on 24 January 2020. Activities are ongoing but work progress has slowed down due to COVID-19 pandemic.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43253/43253-026-apfs-en_7.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Nov 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43253/43253-026-eia-en_15.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43253/43253-026-esmr-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Apr 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43253/43253-026-sddr-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: River Basin profiles of Ghataprabha (K3) and Malaprabha (K4) sub-basins are finalized.The River Basin Profile of Middle Krishna (K2) is under review.River Basin plans are being prepared and are in the advanced stage for the Middle Krishna sub-basin.Under Tranche 2: 731 WRD staff (of which 232 are women) - 122%, are trained in IWRM.471 WRD engineers are trained in several thematic training courses.The KWRIS Phase-3 contract has been signed, and the modules are under development.Asset management plan is under preparation by the engaged PSC-2.Wide range of activities are being carried out namely DGPS survey of VNC canal network, mapping of WUCS boundaries with survey numbers, Layers of Main Canal, Distributaries, Minors, FICs and related Pipe Outlets and anicuts. The Hydraulic particulars and administration boundaries are being generated and all the above is being synthesized to update in Web GIS server.Tranche 2 VNC is being implemented in two packages: Package-1: Civil works (excluding works in Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve and Hampi World Heritage Area) at an estimated cost of INR 3,739 million are under progress. As of 31 May 2024, a total of 149 km of lining work along main canals out of 196.54 km (76%) and 1,028 structures out of 1,089 (94%) are completed. About 16 km (37%) lining of distributaries completed against target of 43.51 km, 1 km progress achieved against target of 152 kms in minors and 0.767 km (35%) anicuts constructed out of 2.202 km.Package-2: Works will upgrade the 8 anicuts in the Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve and the Turtha canal 18.69 km covering a total CCA of 931 ha in the Hampi World Heritage Area. As of 31 May 2024, 5.7 km of 8 Anicut work completed (58%) out of 9.78 km. The canal lining of 2.80 km (15%) out of 18.69 km and 22 structures (13%) out of 168 structures completed.VNC-CPP CAD works: As of 31 May 2024, 483 CAD work packages out of 598 were awarded to 29 WUCS.Clearance from the National Board for Wildlife, Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change, was obtained vide letter dated 16 November 2022.DCF, Koppal, in a letter dated 8 December 2023, instructed the concerned RFOs to oversee the works in Anegundi Channel under package 1. Further, a work permit letter to KNNL was issued on 19 March 2024.The regional commissioner granted Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary (DSBS) area work permission, headed by the Monitoring Committee, on 21 March 2024. Further, no objection letter was received from DCF Vijayanagara on 8 April 2024.As of 31 May 2024, all 29 WUCS are established. MOUs with KNNL have been signed for irrigation water management, water charges collection, and O&M responsibilities (this is considered 'established ).Exclusive training with Farmers Field Schools, Demonstrations, and other training on improved on-farm water application methods is being carried out under the Sustainable Agriculture Program.Women are represented on the management boards of the established 29 WUCS 110 (32%). As per the statutory provisions, the total number of office bearers among 29 WUCS is 348, of which 344 positions are filled.Women sub-committees: As of 31 May 2024, 58 women sub-committees formed with 921 members.Overall Capacity Building activity: As part of capacity-building programs, 1,364 events covering 35,665 participants, of which 24,075 are men (67%) and 11,590 are women (33%), have been completed.Training on the Gender Empowerment and Social Inclusion (GESI) concept and mainstreaming women, women in irrigation management, and principles of water resource management have been conducted for 8,240 WUCS members of total farmers of 29 WUCS of which men comprised 5,774 (70%), and women comprised 2,466 (30%).As of 31 May 2024, five workshops on gender concepts, women mainstreaming, and water resource management principles were held for KNNL staff. A total of 126 staff, 92 men and 34 women, have been trained.Note: The total number of sanctioned technical staff of KNNL at ICZ, Munirabad, is 299, of which 200 are filled-up positions. Of these, 163 are men, and 37 are women.Completed. Project MIS in place, and data updated from time to time. In addition, a user-friendly app to monitor the modernization (civil) works was developed and is under use by KNNL engineers.Finance Department, Government of Karnataka has not concurred TLBC project as standalone project.In progress.ACIWRM: QPRs up to Q4 2023 submitted and QPR for Q1 2024 is under preparation.KNNL: QPRs up to Q4 2023 submitted and QPR for Q1 2024 is under preparation.Annual Progress Report (APR) for CY 2023 is submitted.Revised SMRs for the period of (i) Oct 2021-Mar 2022, (ii) Apr-Sep 2022, (iii) Oct 2022-March 2023 and (iv) April-Sep 2023 are submitted. ADB has provided comments and compliance is awaited.Due Diligence Report on Package 1 works in Heritage Area submitted on 10-Nov-2023 and the same has been submitted to Archeological Survey of India after vetted by Heritage Conservation Specialist on 5-Mar-2024.Sex-disaggregated data being collected and compiled for reporting for all events.
